proposals.proposal: One explicit logical owner account with finite budget; original local patches debit normalized shares and cannot mint/refill stock on activation. Frond shares are exact normalized area expressions; finite interval enclosures do not replace conservation.

Fixed original patch selections with all-of semantics and zero additional fuel; follower heat/damage routes into its existing owner budget. Local cold/native/retired state must not reparent to a distant survivor.

Source-local native-scale masks retain original geometry/ranges, including front/back/edges for proven thin-axis sheets. Partial triangle retirement needs reviewed common physical/query/render semantics; membership alone cannot authorize deleting the whole triangle or sheet.

These source-local damage masks use existing .5/1.06/.5 scale, distinct from 1/2.12/1 authored tiles. Mapping to canonical native cell/region IDs needs pinned original world grid/compiler admission; no canonical selector is installed.

Zero combustible stock with explicit source physical screening, local damage and retirement. Do not infer physical participation from the absence of fuel, or use a quantity reference as physical closedness.

Sheet/component frame support is separate from local breakage masks. Keep fixed original local frame ports; require a live path through the same remaining original glass component. No direct frame contact is required at every mask, no adjacent-pane brace and no surviving-frame remap. Mechanical fastening/capacity remains unapproved.
Preserve the 208 top-level plant patches; canopy/clump envelopes need finer original-source local damage state before first wiring. A first hit cannot retire a whole crown or all owner followers.

The consumer must maintain retained triangle-portion/native-mask connectivity within each original glass component, local frame-port liveness and path-loss behavior. The representative source paths prove pristine connectivity only. Canonical native admission, dynamic connectivity and all glass paths remain unproved/uninstalled.
